name: llvm-project
description: The LLVM Project is a collection of modular and reusable compiler and toolchain technologies.
one_liner: Core plumbing that turns programming-language code into the machine instructions a computer actually runs — deep compiler infrastructure used by other developer tools.
buyer: No direct end buyer; this is infrastructure companies like Apple and Google build products on top of, not something a small business would ever touch directly.
business_use_cases: A chip company uses it to build a custom compiler backend for a new processor architecture.
A niche-language startup builds their compiler toolchain on top of it instead of writing one from scratch.
A static-analysis tooling company builds a paid code-quality product using its analysis infrastructure.

money_ideas.idea: Specialized compiler-consulting services for hardware or language companies.

steal_this: No realistic weekend project here for a non-specialist — this is deep infrastructure for compiler engineers, not a business opportunity for most builders.
